rec.name: Pest Cards (Metaobject-Driven Tile Grid)
rec.status: Built — client approved on dev theme; live theme rollout pending (as of 2025-09-17)

what.text: A grid of image tiles ("Pest Cards") on a collection page, one per pest type. Each card has a title, an image and a link to the related pest article or page. The cards are pulled from a dedicated metaobject instead of manually configured theme blocks, and are displayed alphabetically by title. First used on the 'Schädlingsbekämpfung' (pest control) collection of Green Guardia.

why.text: Visual tiles let shoppers self-identify their problem ("I have ants") in one click and move straight to the relevant guide or product range. This shortens the path from problem to solution and reduces bounce on broad collection pages. Alphabetical ordering makes a long list predictable and easy to scan. This rationale is inferred; the ticket does not state it.

how.text: 1) Create a metaobject definition for pest cards with fields Title, Image and Link (URL). 2) Add the section to the collection template so it loops over all entries of that metaobject and renders them as linked image tiles, sorted alphabetically by Title. 3) To add a pest, copy the target article or page URL, create a new metaobject entry, and fill in Title, Image and the pasted Link. The move from manual blocks to metaobject entries was explained in a Loom video that is not available here, so the exact reasoning is unknown. Likely benefits are easier client-side maintenance and no limit from the block count (inferred).

items: Metaobject entry fields: Title, Image, Link
Source metaobject selection in the theme section (inferred)
Section heading and grid columns (not confirmed in source)

dependencies.text: Shopify metaobject definition for pest cards (Title, Image, Link). A Focal theme with a custom 'CRO | Pest Cards' section. Pest articles or pages must exist so there is something to link to. The ticket does not say whether the number of tiles is capped.

items: Click-through from cards to articles or products
Conversion rate of sessions that clicked a card
